statements.impact_statement: Netty epoll native transport vulnerability fixed in 4.2.13.Final. Liquibase is a database migration CLI tool that does not run any network server. netty-transport-native-epoll provides the Linux epoll(7) native transport for outbound client connections. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport. There is no inbound socket for an attacker to exploit.
